rawFindings.title: `res.sendFile` now skips its callback on `HEAD` requests
rawFindings.explanation: The new `sendfile` implementation only registers `onFinished(res, onfinish)` after removing the earlier `file.on('file', onfile)`/`onFinished(res, onerror)` path. For a `HEAD` request, `file.pipe(res)` never emits a body stream, so `onfinish` is never reached and the user callback passed to `res.sendFile(path, fn)` is no longer invoked.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep a completion listener that fires when the response finishes even if no body is streamed, or explicitly call the callback after handling the `HEAD` case.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: `app.use((req,res)=>res.sendFile('/tmp/name.txt', cb));` followed by `HEAD /` leaves `cb` pending forever instead of calling it with no error.

rawFindings.title: `res.sendFile` now skips its callback on conditional 304 responses
rawFindings.explanation: By removing the prior `onFinished(res, onerror)` handling, the callback is no longer scheduled when the response is completed early after `req.fresh` causes `res.send()` to emit a 304. In that case the file stream may not reach a normal end event, so the `fn(err)` passed to `res.sendFile` is never called.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a finish/error hook that invokes the callback when the response ends before the file stream completes, including 304 responses.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: `GET /` with a matching `If-None-Match` header returns 304, but `res.sendFile(path, cb)` never invokes `cb`, so code waiting for completion hangs.
